svg.title: Every line through Kallio
svg.desc: Real HSL geometry for the metro and trams 1, 3, 6, 7, 8 and 9 where they cross the Piritori board, drawn on one sheet with shared corridors fanned into parallel strands.
svg.text: metro + trams 1 3 6 7 8 9 · shared corridors fanned apart · one hue per line — a legibility device, NOT an HSL system
per-line colour — 1/6/7 are Wikidata's values; 3 is deepened off it to clear line 1, and 8/9 have none published

g.text: board anchor · stop names are on the per-line plates

svg.text: © Helsingin seudun liikenne (HSL) · CC BY 4.0 · feed 2026-08-21 04:06:03 · the fan is a drawing device — the real track is the centre of each bundle
grey underlay = corridors that carry service, weighted by weekly trips. NOT a street map: a street with no route on it is not in it (§10.8)
